name: create_task
description: Creates a new task. Tasks are used to track the activities done to achieve a project.

id.description: optional pre-generated UUID for the task (server-side callers can pre-allocate ids so updates correlate; agents should leave this blank)

description.description: precise description of the task, should include relevant details of what needs to be done and how

createdBy.description: the id of the agent that creates the task

assignee.description: the id of the agent assigned to the task, can be identical to 'createdBy' field if the task is auto-assigned

projectId.description: the id of the project if available, if not the tool will try to infer the project from the environment

name: update_task
description: Updates a task. Task updates are used to track activity relative to task achievement

newStatus.description: the new status of the task, can only take the values : 'CREATED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED','ABORTED','ON_ERROR'

newComment.description: precise description of the task update, should include relevant details of what was done and how

updatedBy.description: the id of the agent that updates the task

name: read_task
description: Reads a task. Helpful to find all needed information to accomplish the task.

name: save_agent_state
description: Records or updates an agent's runtime state for a project (cycle counts, token usage, latency). Each call appends a new state snapshot to the agent's run history.

projectId.description: the id of the project the agent is working on

agentId.description: the agent's id within the team

status.description: READY | WORKING | THINKING | USING_TOOL | WAITING | STOPPED

latency.description: wall-clock latency in milliseconds for the latest cycle

name: save_agent_transition
description: Records a directed handoff or delegation from one agent to another within a project's run.

transitionId.description: unique id for this transition (uuid recommended)

name: save_agent_message
description: Records a message produced by an agent during a project's run (system prompt, user input, model output, tool result).

name: save_project_state
description: Updates the high-level state of a project (status, deliverable URL).

url.description: deliverable URL once the project completes (s3://, https://, file:// allowed)
